description: TrancaPatch a team to build amazing stuff
summary:
TrancaPatch is a real-time biomedical telemetry and 3D digital twin platform developed to monitor and protect astronaut health during crewed space missions. Built with an event-driven NestJS backend, RethinkDB, and an interactive React 19 3D viewer (@google/model-viewer), the system maps live biometric feeds across five anatomical systems: external body, skeletal, cardiovascular, nervous, and internal organs, complemented by Google Gemini AI for clinical diagnostics and countermeasure recommendations.

The platform addresses the challenge of tracking astronaut physiology amidst extreme spaceflight hazards—such as microgravity-induced bone demineralization, radiation exposure, and cardiovascular shifts—which are conventionally buried in complex, fragmented data streams. By translating multi-sensor streams into an intuitive, color-coded 3D avatar pushed via low-latency WebSockets, it provides immediate visual clarity on anatomical anomalies and pain levels.

This is critical for deep-space and long-duration exploration (e.g., Artemis or Mars missions), where communication latency precludes real-time guidance from Earth-based medical teams. TrancaPatch empowers orbital crews and flight surgeons with autonomous medical situational awareness, enabling prompt interventions to safeguard astronaut well-being.
details:
Frontend Architecture: Built with React 19, TypeScript, and Vite as a high-performance SPA. Leverages @google/model-viewer for interactive 3D cardiovascular/anatomical visualization, React Router for navigation, and socket.io-client for real-time telemetry ingestion and UI reactivity.

Backend Architecture: Modular, event-driven service engineered with NestJS 11 utilizing CQRS patterns and internal event emitters. Provides REST APIs documented via Swagger alongside a dedicated bi-directional Socket.IO gateway for low-latency telemetry streaming. Leverages RethinkDB for real-time reactive document persistence and integrates the Google GenAI SDK for automated medical insights.
